title: Integral bounded by the $L^p$ norm
statement: Let $(\alpha,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $p\in[1,\infty]$, and let $f\colon\alpha\to\mathbb R$ belong to $L^p(\mu)$. Then $\left|\int f\,d\mu\right|\leq\|f\|_{L^p(\mu)}$.
